description: Single storey rear extension with mono pitch roof;  installation of  window to the side at second floor level; external alterations (demolition of single storey rear extension)
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span arial="">The proposed extension by virtue of its resultant scale, bulk and footprint would result in a visually obtrusive addition, out of character with the prevailing pattern of development. The extension would result in a cramped rear garden space inadequately proportioned to the 3-bed family-sized dwelling and represent</span><span arial=""> overdevelopment of the plot, failing to respect the character of the host dwellinghouse and the plot size of the application site. This is contrary to the aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041) and Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021) and Harrow SPD 'Residential Design' (2010).</span></span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="line-height:normal">The proposed single-storey rear extension by reason of its bulk and scale would result in adverse impact to the neighbouring amenity of existing and future occupiers at No.1 Swift Close due to the resultant reduction in the private rear amenity space, and its overbearing nature resulting in an increased sense of enclosure, loss of light/overshadowing and visual dominance to the neighbouring properties at No.10 Drinkwater Road and No.3 Swift Close. The proposals are found to be contrary to Policy GR1.C of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041) and D3 of the London Plan (2021).</span></span></span></p>
